title: TixFox: Sell Event Tickets for 39¢ (pixel mascot)
summary: A 38 s voiced product explainer for TixFox, an event-ticketing app, with a halftone/dithered pixel fox mascot. Each scene is a flat pastel colour field (peach, periwinkle, yellow, mint, sky, lilac, ink) with a big left-aligned headline that builds word-by-word in sync with the voiceover, the key phrase on a solid highlighter block, and a chunky rebuilt UI card or phone on the right (ticket fee bar, event page, live sales chart, QR checkout, payout card). Fox avatar sits bottom-left as a recurring presenter badge. Friendly, punchy, very clear.
fit_reason: Headline-as-caption synced to VO + one UI card per benefit is ideal for voiced feature explainers; swap the pastel rainbow for brand navy/yellow and the fox for Andrew's avatar badge.

palette.mood: flat pastel colour-block scenes, playful but tidy; ink #131316 for text and UI outlines

typography.display: clean neo-grotesk regular/medium (Inter / Suisse Int'l) for headlines, mono for HUD and small UI labels
typography.size_behaviour: large left-aligned 2-3 line headline in the left 40% of frame
typography.notes: Key words sit on a solid highlighter rectangle (orange #e4793f or yellow #f0ee3d) with no padding radius. Mono breadcrumbs top-left ('// 03 · pricing') and 'TIXFOX 00:00:09:18' top-right.

text_animation: highlighter block snaps in behind key word
horizontal motion-blur whip out of the whole text block
captions: word-by-word as the headline itself: left-aligned large text building in sync with VO, key phrase on orange or yellow highlighter block, no separate subtitle bar
motion: UI card slides in from right with hard drop shadow (offset black)
fee bar fills/empties to show cost
phone slides up, taps with '1 tap / 3 taps' badges
live sales bar chart ticks up with order toasts
dithered coins/tickets spin around the logo
transitions: horizontal whip-pan with motion blur into next colour field
graphic_elements: rebuilt UI cards with 2px ink outline and hard offset shadow
ui_treatment: Rebuilt, chunky neo-brutalist UI cards and phone screens (ink outlines, hard shadows, flat fills) on the right half; headline on the left.

sound.sfx: whooshes on whips, pops, cash ticks
sound.voiceover: yes - friendly, fast US male/female ad read ('Selling tickets to your next event? Tired of fees eating into every sale? Meet TixFox. Just 39 cents a ticket...')
sound.sync: text builds exactly on VO words; scene whips on sentence boundaries

signature_moves: headline builds word-by-word with the VO, key phrase on a highlighter block
one flat pastel colour per chapter with whip-pan between
mascot avatar badge bottom-left as a constant presenter
neo-brutalist UI cards with ink outlines and hard shadows

best_segments.what: VO-synced headline builds with orange highlighter, then problem card with fee list, whip out
Pricing chapter: 'Just 39¢ a ticket.' / 'No monthly fees.' with fee bar and $0 cards
Share the link → whip to mint 'Watch sales roll in, live.' with live chart

recreate.how: Remotion with word timestamps from TTS/whisper: render headline words as they are spoken, highlighter divs behind key words, rebuilt UI cards in HTML/CSS (border 2px, box-shadow 6px 6px 0 ink), whip transitions via translateX + blur. Mascot as a pre-made image.
recreate.prompt: Voiced SaaS explainer on flat pastel colour fields: a large left-aligned headline builds word by word with the voiceover, the key phrase on a solid orange highlighter block, a chunky ink-outlined UI card with hard shadow on the right, a round mascot avatar bottom-left, whip-pan to the next colour.
